testcase.name: the fingerprint is the data version alone without a manifest and the version plus the manifest with one
a manifest that is not JSON or has no valid fingerprint reads as null
the fingerprint of a manifest is read from its fingerprint field
a generated manifest is what an independent hashing of the CSV gives
the build script declares the task that writes the manifest the app reads
the expected fingerprint reads the manifest asset
the manifest is not one of the assets the importer reads as data
a missing or unreadable manifest falls back to the data version without throwing and stays stable
